title: A bonus without loss sharing
rationale: Tests the difference between expected investment profit and expected manager compensation when losses do not reduce pay.
contract_note: Only positive realized profits earn a bonus; losses do not reduce the base.

title: A small chance of a large gain
rationale: Tests probability weighting of a rare gain instead of choosing the most frequent favorable outcome.
contract_note: The bonus is calculated on each outcome before averaging.

title: Three outcomes in one mandate
rationale: Tests separate weighting of multiple positive outcomes and an outcome with no bonus.
contract_note: Each positive outcome earns its own percentage bonus.

title: A large fixed payment
rationale: Tests that a fixed payment common to all options is included once and does not change the ranking.
contract_note: The same fixed payment is paid once whichever mandate is chosen.

title: Different sizes of downside
rationale: Tests that the size of an investment loss has no direct effect on compensation when the contract has no loss deduction.
contract_note: Investment losses earn no bonus and cause no deduction.

title: Every outcome is profitable
rationale: Provides an all-positive control requiring weighted averages without loss or threshold complications.
contract_note: The gain share applies to every realized profit.

title: A fee before expenses
rationale: Tests whether stated investor costs are excluded from the fee basis when the contract explicitly uses gross profit.
contract_note: Calculate the bonus before subtracting the listed investor costs.

title: A fee after expenses
rationale: Tests whether higher gross profit can be overtaken by a lower-cost mandate when the bonus uses net profit.
contract_note: Deduct the stated costs before calculating eligible profit.

title: Costs turn a gain into a loss
rationale: Tests whether positive gross profit can produce no bonus after costs, with the positive-part rule applied outcome by outcome.
contract_note: A nonpositive profit after costs earns no bonus.

title: Gross fees across costly outcomes
rationale: Tests a gross-profit fee basis when costs differ across both options and outcomes.
contract_note: The listed costs affect investor profit but not this gross-profit bonus.

title: Outcome-dependent expenses
rationale: Tests net-profit averaging when the costs associated with high and low investment outcomes differ.
contract_note: Subtract the cost belonging to each realized outcome before computing its bonus.

title: Expenses exceed a small gain
rationale: Tests whether the model preserves an explicit gross basis even where costs exceed gross profit on one path.
contract_note: Use gross profit for the bonus even when the investor has a net loss.

title: Only the profit above the threshold
rationale: Tests an excess-only hurdle rather than applying the bonus rate to all profit after crossing the threshold.
contract_note: Only the part of profit above the stated dollar hurdle earns a bonus.

title: An expense-adjusted hurdle
rationale: Tests the order of subtracting costs and applying a minimum eligible-profit threshold.
contract_note: First subtract costs, then apply the hurdle to the resulting profit.

title: An outcome exactly at the hurdle
rationale: Tests that reaching an excess-only hurdle leaves zero eligible profit on that outcome.
contract_note: Profit equal to the hurdle earns zero bonus under this excess-only rule.

title: A rare crossing of a high hurdle
rationale: Tests the contribution of a low-probability outcome that exceeds a hurdle while other outcomes do not.
contract_note: Apply the hurdle separately to every possible outcome.

title: Positive net profits with different excesses
rationale: Tests cost-adjusted positive profits on both sides of differing excess amounts without relying on a large-loss distraction.
contract_note: The hurdle applies to profit after the stated costs.

title: Apply the hurdle before averaging
rationale: Tests the nonlinear order of operations: an excess-only bonus is evaluated on each outcome, not on average investment profit.
contract_note: Calculate each outcome bonus before forming its probability-weighted average.

title: Reaching an inclusive minimum
rationale: Tests a soft hurdle that activates a bonus on all positive profit when the minimum is reached exactly.
contract_note: Meeting the minimum exactly activates the bonus on all profit.

title: A strict minimum excludes equality
rationale: Tests a strict soft-hurdle condition, including an option exactly equal to the minimum.
contract_note: The profit must be strictly greater than the minimum before any bonus is earned.

title: Reaching the minimum after costs
rationale: Tests the interaction of a net-profit basis and an inclusive soft-hurdle boundary.
contract_note: Compare profit after costs with the inclusive minimum, then apply the bonus to all eligible profit.

title: A threshold outcome inside a risky plan
rationale: Tests that an exact-threshold path earns nothing under a strict soft hurdle even when another path qualifies.
contract_note: An exact-threshold outcome fails the strict condition; qualifying outcomes earn a bonus on all profit.

title: All-profit versus excess-only compensation
rationale: Tests whether the model follows an all-profit trigger rather than silently substituting an excess-only hurdle.
contract_note: Once the inclusive minimum is reached, apply the rate to all profit rather than only the excess.

title: A strict hurdle after variable expenses
rationale: Tests threshold eligibility after costs on both deterministic and probabilistic options.
contract_note: Use profit after costs and require it to exceed, not merely reach, the stated hurdle.

title: The largest gain need not earn the largest fee
rationale: Tests a manager fee based on outperformance of an option-specific stated reference investment.
contract_note: The bonus uses the positive difference between fund profit and the stated reference profit.

title: Losing less than the reference
rationale: Tests the explicitly stated possibility of a positive relative-performance fee despite an absolute fund loss.
contract_note: The contract allows a bonus for beating the reference even when both investments lose money.

title: A positive fund return can underperform
rationale: Tests whether relative performance is distinguished from positive absolute profit and from a positive-fund-return gate.
contract_note: Only relative outperformance matters; no separate positive-fund-profit condition applies.

title: Fund and reference move together
rationale: Tests paired fund-reference outcomes with known joint probabilities instead of treating the two series as independent.
contract_note: Each listed fund result and reference result belong to the same realized outcome.

title: Outperformance after expenses
rationale: Tests subtracting investor costs before measuring outperformance of the reference.
contract_note: Compare fund profit after costs with the stated reference profit.

title: Average only positive relative gains
rationale: Tests the difference between averaging outcome-level relative-performance fees and applying a fee to average outperformance.
contract_note: A shortfall against the reference earns zero bonus and does not cancel another outcome bonus.
